notes: renderer=software; unthrottled_redraw=true; frame_ms = interval between consecutive about_to_wait calls that follow a winit RedrawRequested (i.e. after Slint render + softbuffer/GL present returned, measured from the winit CustomApplicationHandler); redraw requested continuously from about_to_wait (bypasses Slint's 60Hz Timer frame throttle when unthrottled=true); first 2s warm-up not recorded. canvas = one Slint Rectangle element per shape (repeater over VecModel, all rows set_row_data each frame); software renderer ignores drop-shadow (BoxShadow draw is a TODO) and rounded clip radius (rect clip only); graph = Path element, commands string rebuilt each frame (10000 pts)
